data: Microsoft's net income rose from $72,738 million in fiscal 2022 (year ended June 30, 2022) to $88,136 million in fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024), according to the income statement in its fiscal 2024 Form 10-K. That is an increase of $15,398 million, or about 21.2% over the two years. Most of the growth came in fiscal 2024. Net income was essentially flat in fiscal 2023 at $72,361 million, slightly below fiscal 2022, before rising about 21.8% in fiscal 2024 as revenue grew to $245,122 million.
